blurb: Turkovich Family Wines is a small, family-owned winery in Western Yolo County focused on sustainable farming and crafting exceptional wines. They offer wine tastings, private event rentals, wine club memberships, and farm products. The winery has two locations: a tasting room in downtown Winters and a seasonal winery and farm on Buckeye Road.
